summary: Agomab Therapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the results of its Special and Extraordinary General Shareholders' Meeting. Shareholders approved the appointments of Marino Garcia and Dr. Naimish Patel as non-executive directors, and approved a consolidation and split adjustment of outstanding pre-IPO warrants to align them with the share split implemented at the February 2026 IPO. These are routine governance and capital-structure housekeeping matters, not a special situation. The filing maps to a US 8-K furnishing shareholder meeting results and board appointments; no deal terms, stake changes, or transactional mechanics are present.
